decisions.reason: Although it was not later observed on the website, this high-resolution printer fits the firm's core marking hardware business, so a growing R&D-led supplier would more likely retain or subsume it than exit the capability.
This numbering module is somewhat niche and could be folded into a broader software package, but the underlying function supports variable-data printing and traceability, so we would keep it.
Coding on non-absorbent surfaces is a standard industrial requirement squarely within the firm's established offer, making discontinuation relatively unlikely.
The decoding app is less central than core equipment and may face pruning if usage is limited, but it still supports the firm's digitalization and traceability ecosystem.
An inline code verification system directly reinforces compliance and end-to-end traceability, which are strategic priorities for this firm.
Print-layout software improves usability and common operation across systems, though there is some chance it is later bundled into other software rather than removed outright.
